abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 70 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 77 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 123 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 71 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 72 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 108 | 450 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
